description: This file defines API routes for CRUD operations related to modems in a web application, using FastAPI. It includes route handlers for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting modems, with dependencies on database sessions and modem service functions.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all registered modems, returning a list of ModemOut.

methods.name: ModemOut get_modem(modem_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific modem by its ID, returning a ModemOut or raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: ModemOut update_modem(modem_id: int, payload: ModemUpdate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing modem by ID, returning the updated ModemOut.

methods.name: None delete_modem(modem_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a modem by ID, returning 204 No Content or raising 404 if not found.
